facts.material: printed circuit board with electronic components and hydrogen gas sensing element
facts.function: detect hydrogen gas and produce an electrical signal
facts.form: assembled PCB (assembly, part of an apparatus)
facts.end_use: part of electrical gas detection/analysis apparatus

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9027 covers gas analysis apparatus and parts; chapter 90 note 2(b) sends parts suitable solely/principally for one kind of apparatus with that apparatus
GRI 6: 9027.90 parts, electrical, of articles of 9027.10.20

rejected_alternatives.reason: transducer/sensor board ruling N325069 (air-flow sensor) treated as general electrical machine; here the specific heading 9027 for gas analysis parts applies
bare printed circuits only; this is an assembly with components
complete gas analyser; item is only the sensor PCB assembly

missing_facts: Whether the board is a complete standalone detector or a part of a larger analyzer
Whether solely used with gas analysis apparatus
classification.rationale: Sensor PCB assembly dedicated to hydrogen gas detection is a part of gas analysis apparatus under 9027 via Ch.90 note 2(b). N325069 (sensor board under 8543.70.45) is cited only as the contrasting alternative where the sensor is a general transducer.
